root_selection: Two-table public subset, adult18..79,64keys, exact five-column long output; no execution grant implied.

source_verification.method: Bounded read-only local parsing of two cached public XPT files with bundled pandas 2.2.3; official CDC codebooks browsed and frequencies compared. No raw download, cloud, provider, kernel, app runtime or repository changes.

BPXO_L.eligibility: Age 8 years and older, subject to documented arm/medical exclusions; file membership does not guarantee a usable reading.

adult_cohort.definition: DEMO_L records satisfying 18 <= RIDAGEYR <= 79, before any BP availability filter. This explicitly excludes age-80-plus topcoded records; it is not all adults or a national cohort.
adult_cohort.reason_recommended: Matches the existing donor age definition while preserving unmatched participants and missing readings; avoids the donor complete-case filter.

selection_rule: Form the explicit adult DEMO cohort.
Left join the three BPXO systolic columns on SEQN with validate=one_to_one and indicator=join_status.
Partition into disjoint buckets: left_only; both with 3 missing readings; both with 1 or 2 missing readings; both with 0 missing readings.
Sort each bucket by numeric SEQN ascending. Take first 8 unmatched, first 8 all-missing, first 8 partly-missing, and first 40 complete. Union and sort by SEQN. No randomness.
Extract DEMO selected columns for those 64 SEQN and BPXO selected columns for the 56 present SEQN. Retain original values and missing positions; introduce no source rows or values.
fixture.csv_encoding: UTF-8, LF, header, final newline; integer-valued numeric fields as base-10 integers; missing numeric cells empty; rows ascending numeric SEQN.

required_output.bpxo_match_definition: matched = SEQN present in supplied BPXO table; no_BPXO_record = SEQN absent from supplied BPXO table. Neither category asserts exam attendance or reason for absence.

task: Use DEMO as left table. Validate a one_to_one SEQN join, retain bpxo_match, melt exactly BPXOSY1/BPXOSY2/BPXOSY3 into reading1/2/3 and systolic_mm_hg. Preserve all three rows per participant, every source value and every missing position. Explain observational units, unmatched versus within-component missingness, and verify lossless pivot roundtrip.
missing_value_contract: CDC documents numeric dot missing for the selected BP fields; preserve as missing in CSV/pandas, not 0.
Selected BP fields have no documented refusal/dont-know sentinels; do not apply a generic 7/9/77/99 recode.
Do not fill missing measurements, average readings, drop incomplete participants, or infer why a particular reading is absent.
Retain join_status so a missing BP row and a present BP row with missing readings remain distinguishable.
No observed systolic zero exists in either cached source or selected fixture; fabricate none.
checker_assertions: Require exact supplied source bytes/hashes and column order; both sources have unique nonmissing integral SEQN.

survey_boundary: This task makes no population estimates. Population inference would require current CDC survey weights and design guidance; the selected participants/readings must not be treated as an independent national sample. No blood analytes, clinical thresholds or medical advice.
donor_limitations: INFO521 build_nhanes.py labels _L as 2021-2022; official release is August 2021-August 2023.

The donor prose cites WTMECPRP for _L; official DEMO_L instead documents WTMEC2YR for MEC exams. Weights are excluded from this chosen wrangling fixture.
